title: Perfect

cues.en: I found a love, for me
cues.zh: 我找到了屬於我的摯愛
cues.text: I found a love, for me

cues.en: Darling, just dive right in and follow my lead
cues.zh: 親愛的，只要全心投入並跟隨我的腳步
cues.text: Darling, just dive right in and follow my lead

cues.en: Well, I found a girl, beautiful and sweet
cues.zh: 我找到了一個漂亮又可愛的女孩
cues.text: Well, I found a girl, beautiful and sweet

cues.en: Oh, I never knew you were the someone waiting for me
cues.zh: 噢，我從來不知道你就是那個等著我的人
cues.text: Oh, I never knew you were the someone waiting for me

cues.en: 'Cause we were just kids when we fell in love
cues.zh: 因為我們墜入愛河時只是孩子
cues.text: 'Cause we were just kids when we fell in love

cues.en: Not knowing what it was
cues.zh: 不知道是什麼
cues.text: Not knowing what it was

cues.en: I will not give you up this time
cues.zh: 這次我不會放棄你
cues.text: I will not give you up this time

cues.en: But darling, just kiss me slow
cues.zh: 但親愛的，慢慢吻我
cues.text: But darling, just kiss me slow

cues.en: Your heart is all I own
cues.zh: 你的心是我所有的一切
cues.text: Your heart is all I own

cues.en: And in your eyes, you're holding mine
cues.zh: 在你眼中，你握著我的
cues.text: And in your eyes, you're holding mine

cues.en: Baby, I'm dancing in the dark
cues.zh: 寶貝，我在黑暗中跳舞
cues.text: Baby, I'm dancing in the dark

cues.en: With you between my arms
cues.zh: With you between my arms
cues.text: With you between my arms

cues.en: Barefoot on the grass
cues.zh: 赤腳踩草
cues.text: Barefoot on the grass

cues.en: Listening to our favourite song
cues.zh: 聆聽我們最喜歡的歌曲
cues.text: Listening to our favourite song

cues.en: When you said you looked a mess
cues.zh: 當你說你看起來一團糟
cues.text: When you said you looked a mess

cues.en: I whispered underneath my breath
cues.zh: 我在心中輕聲細語
cues.text: I whispered underneath my breath

cues.en: But you heard it
cues.zh: 但你聽到了
cues.text: But you heard it

cues.en: Darling, you look perfect tonight
cues.zh: 親愛的，你今晚看起來很完美
cues.text: Darling, you look perfect tonight

cues.en: Well, I found a woman, stronger than anyone I know
cues.zh: 嗯，我找到了一個女人，比我認識的任何人都要強壯
cues.text: Well, I found a woman, stronger than anyone I know

cues.en: She shares my dreams, I hope that someday I'll share her home
cues.zh: 她分享我的夢想，我希望有一天我會分享她的家
cues.text: She shares my dreams, I hope that someday I'll share her home

cues.en: I found a lover, to carry more than just my secrets
cues.zh: 我找到了一個情人，帶著的不僅僅是我的秘密
cues.text: I found a lover, to carry more than just my secrets

cues.en: To carry love, to carry children of our own
cues.zh: 攜帶愛，攜帶我們自己的孩子
cues.text: To carry love, to carry children of our own

cues.en: We are still kids, but we're so in love
cues.zh: 我們還是孩子，但我們是如此相愛
cues.text: We are still kids, but we're so in love

cues.en: Fighting against all odds
cues.zh: 全力以赴
cues.text: Fighting against all odds

cues.en: I know we'll be alright this time
cues.zh: 我知道這次我們會沒事的
cues.text: I know we'll be alright this time

cues.en: Darling, just hold my hand
cues.zh: 親愛的，握住我的手
cues.text: Darling, just hold my hand

cues.en: Be my girl, I'll be your man
cues.zh: 做我的女孩，我會做你的男人
cues.text: Be my girl, I'll be your man

cues.en: I see my future in your eyes
cues.zh: 我在你的眼中看到了我的未來
cues.text: I see my future in your eyes

cues.text: Listening to our favorite song

cues.en: When I saw you in that dress, looking so beautiful
cues.zh: 當我看到你穿著那件衣服，看起來很漂亮
cues.text: When I saw you in that dress, looking so beautiful

cues.en: I don't deserve this
cues.zh: 我不配
cues.text: I don't deserve this

cues.en: Darling, you look perfect tonight
cues.zh: 親愛的，你今晚看起來很完美
cues.text: Darling, you look perfect tonight

cues.zh: 我對我所看到的充滿信心
cues.text: I have faith in what I see

cues.en: Now I know I have met an angel in person
cues.zh: 現在我知道我親自遇到了天使
cues.text: Now I know I have met an angel in person
